title: 第5章 萧玄策的震惊第6章 再见叶净心
content_zh:
萧天快步走向自己原来的院子。
然后收拾一下东西。
其实也没什么东西可以收拾的，可以用家徒四壁来形容。
带上自己的衣物，同时带上一直被萧天背在身上的重剑，来到了翠荷居。
翠荷居位于萧家大院中心靠边的位置。
整体比之前的好了十倍不止，当然这也是为接下来叶萧两家做准备的。
毕竟是萧家族长之子和叶家嫡女。
排面必须给予重视！
安置好后，萧天马上去找自己的父亲萧玄策。
找到了萧玄策，说明了联姻之事。
“父亲，现在孙家和李家，现在动作频频，针对之意，已经摆到了台面上了，所以必须要尽快的想出应对之策。”
萧天道
萧玄策颇为意外的看了自己这个儿子，那么多年了，他啥也不关心，看来自己这个儿子真的长大了。
萧玄策说“最近那两家确实动作颇多，所以我们也做了应对。
特别是你和叶家小姐的婚事可以在家族大比之后就举行。
你也提前做好准备。”
“孩儿明白”
萧天回答道。
“对了，父亲，家族大比我也会参加。”
萧玄策不解的看着萧天，迟疑的说道，“你没有修为，上去会受伤的，所以不想你受伤，我知道你这些年不敢受，心里可能也恨我，但是在你很小的时候就请遍了名医，对你身体的问题都束手无策，所以只能让你受一点气，但至少生命无忧。”

萧天其实能理解，家族里的斗争从来就没有停止过。
萧天也没有多说什么，只是让自身隐藏的修为，泄露一丝气息出来。
浑厚如同实质的气息，就连作为先天八层高手都感到窒息。
萧玄策，大为震惊，半天没有反应过来。
结结巴巴的开口道“天儿你你你…你可以修炼了！”
萧天点点头，淡定说道“已经修炼两年了。”
“那你现在是什么修为？”
萧玄策问道。
“我也不清楚，如果按气息强度应该是先天一层初期。
具体实力不知”
萧天如实说道。
萧玄策再次震惊到了，要知道现在萧家年轻一代公认的第一强者是大长老之子萧强，但也只有锻体八层后期修为。
而萧天整整高了一个大境界，达到了先天层次。
锻体境和先天境的差距是非常巨大的，锻体就是强根基，强血气，但只能利用自身身体的能量。
而当跨入先天境，就能引动一丝自然之力，来帮助战斗，同时还可以加快炼化天地灵气，所以差别简直是天差地别。
可以说一个先天境一层天的修炼者可以吊打二三十个锻体境九层天高手！
关键萧天还是只用了两年时间，就从没有修为到了先天！
content_en:
Xiao Tian quickly walked towards his original yard.
Then pack your things.
In fact, there is nothing to clean up. It can be described as a house with only four walls.
He brought his own clothes and the heavy sword that Xiao Tian had been carrying on his back, and came to Cuiheju.
Cuiheju is located at the center of the Xiao Family Courtyard.
The overall situation is more than ten times better than before. Of course, this is also preparation for the next step of Ye Xiao's family.
After all, she is the son of the head of the Xiao family and the legitimate daughter of the Ye family.
Noodles must be paid attention to!
After settling in, Xiao Tian immediately went to find his father Xiao Xuance.
I found Xiao Xuance and explained the marriage.
"Father, now the Sun family and the Li family are taking frequent actions, and the intention of targeting them has been put on the table, so we must come up with countermeasures as soon as possible."
Xiao Tiandao
Xiao Xuance looked at his son in surprise. After so many years, he didn't care about anything. It seemed that his son had really grown up.
Xiao Xuance said, “Those two companies have indeed made a lot of moves recently, so we have also responded to them.
Especially the marriage between you and Miss Ye's family can be held after the family competition.
You also prepare yourself in advance. "
"The child understands"
Xiao Tian replied.
"By the way, father, I will also participate in the family competition."
Xiao Xuance looked at Xiao Tian in confusion and said hesitantly, "You have no cultivation, you will get hurt if you go up there, so I don't want you to get hurt. I know you have not dared to bear it all these years, and you may hate me in your heart, but when you were very young, you went to all the famous doctors, and they were unable to do anything about your physical problems, so I can only make you suffer a little, but at least your life is safe."
Xiao Tian can actually understand that the struggle in the family has never stopped.
Xiao Tian didn't say anything more, he just let his hidden cultivation level leak out.
The aura that is as thick as substance makes even an eighth-level innate master feel suffocated.
Xiao Xuance was so shocked that he didn't react for a long time.
He stammered and said, "Tian'er, you, you, you... you can practice now!"
Xiao Tian nodded and said calmly, "I have been practicing for two years."
"Then what level of cultivation are you at now?"
Xiao Xuance asked.
“I don’t know, but based on the strength of the aura, it should be at the early stage of the innate level.
I don’t know the specific strength.”
Xiao Tian said truthfully.
Xiao Xuance was shocked again. You must know that the younger generation of the Xiao family is now recognized as the strongest person, Xiao Qiang, the son of the great elder, but he is only at the late eighth level of body training.
And Xiao Tian has reached a whole new realm, reaching the innate level.
The gap between the physical training realm and the innate realm is very huge. Physical training is to strengthen the foundation and blood, but it can only use the energy of one's own body.
And when you enter the innate realm, you can activate a trace of natural power to help fight, and at the same time, you can speed up the refining of the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, so the difference is simply huge.
It can be said that a cultivator at the first level of Xiantian Realm can defeat twenty or thirty masters at the ninth level of the Body Forging Realm!
The key point is that it only took Xiao Tian two years to reach Xiantian from no cultivation level!
